messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT 5571234567 - model-warmup failures detected in us-west-2. paging spike + node flaps. Severity: P1 :rotating_light:

maria.chen: noticing a ton of 503s for /v1/generate on model=llama-13b-usw2, looks correlated with warmup errors. I'm on it.

ben.patel: logs show repeated OOM during deserialization on init: `model_loader::deserialize: Error(OutOfMemory)` then `cuda: driver panic, restarting container`.

nina.ortiz: here's a log snippet from the warmup pod (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-15T03:12:21Z] model_loader: loading artifact llama-13b-v2.tar.gz
[2026-03-15T03:12:22Z] deser: protobuf decode failed: claimed size 18446744073709551615 > available
[2026-03-15T03:12:22Z] mem_allocator: attempted allocate 26000000000 bytes -> CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-15T03:12:23Z] runtime: cuda driver reset triggered (reason=page_fault)
[2026-03-15T03:12:24Z] containerd: container exited code=137
```

ryan.gomez: that protobuf size looks like truncation/corrupt artifact, but the OOM and cuda reset suggest we're hitting host memory + GPU pressure when multiple warmups run concurrently (paging).

maria.chen: customer impact so far: several enterprise customers on Dedicated clusters in us-west-2 seeing elevated latencies and intermittent 503s. Alex from CS is on call with one of them. @alex_cs can you confirm?

alex_cs: confirmed — 3 customers reported timeouts for 20-45s on requests to that model, one has an active job. They're ok with failover but want ETA.

ben.patel: quick mitigation suggestions: 1) stop concurrent warmups for llama-13b-v2 in the region, 2) evict any non-essential models from GPUs to free memory, 3) route traffic to fallback model (llama-13b-quant-int8) for customers who allow degraded quality.

maria.chen: I'm going to scale down warmup parallelism and start an eviction sweep. executing: `kubectl -n inference set env ds/warmup WARMUP_PARALLEL=1` and `redwoodctl runtime evict --region=us-west-2 --keep=essential`

deploy-bot: Action accepted: set WARMUP_PARALLEL=1 applied to warmup daemonset. Eviction sweep queued (job/evict-usw2-5571234567). 

nina.ortiz: also found a handful of artifacts with non-matching checksum; deserialization fails occasionally which triggers a retry loop and doubles memory usage. If retries are aggressive we pile up allocations. I recommend a temporary backoff on artifact retries.

maria.chen: good catch. lowering retries now: `kubectl -n inference patch cm warmup-config --patch '{"data":{"artifact_retries":"2"}}'`

ryan.gomez: I'm taking over oncall for this incident. Handing off from maria.chen -> ryan.gomez. I'll coordinate infra-level fixes and customer comms.

oncall: @ryan.gomez acknowledged - taking lead.

ryan.gomez: current mitigation status:
- reduced warmup parallelism -> applied
- eviction sweep kicked off -> 6/12 non-essential models evicted, freed ~48GB GPU memory
- routes: added fallback rule for orgs that opt-in, 2 orgs switched -> immediate relief for them
- artifact retries lowered -> should stop retry storms

ben.patel: note: we still have 2 nodes flapping (node-az3-7 and node-az3-9). Kernel OOM logs show heavy host paging and then GPU hangs. Suggest cordon + replace nodes while we investigate driver version mismatch.

maria.chen: can we throttle new load on those nodes?

ryan.gomez: cordoning now: `kubectl cordon node-az3-7` and `kubectl cordon node-az3-9`. Starting replacement.

deploy-bot: Nodes cordoned. Replacement autoscaling group launching new nodes (asg-inference-usw2-az3).

nina.ortiz: after the eviction the warmup that did succeed shows a different failure class: compile timeout on kernel selection for model-quant-int8 under seq_len=2048. Compile timeouts cause fallback to CPU which eats host mem. We need to bump compile timeout and prioritize kernel cache hits.

ben.patel: temp fix: set `COMPILE_TIMEOUT_MS=120000` on runtime for the region and pre-warm kernel cache for quant-int8 artifact.

ryan.gomez: applying COMPILE_TIMEOUT_MS=120000 now and kicking prewarm cache job. Also updating incident channel with customer impact note and ETA.

alex_cs: customer update sent: "We're mitigating a warmup issue impacting model loads in us-west-2. We've implemented temporary failovers and node replacements; we're tracking progress and will follow up in 30 minutes."

maria.chen: monitoring P95 latency and 503 rate. So far 503 rate dropped 65% after eviction + cordon. Still watching for residual paging.

ryan.gomez: next steps: 1) finish node replacements 2) run artifact integrity sweep 3) add short-term circuit breaker to avoid retry storms 4) postmortem owner = nina.ortiz.

sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE 5571234567 - severity remains P1, mitigation in progress, next update in 20m.

maria.chen: handing back to oncall if stable. If anything new shows up ping me. :thumbsup:"
